name: mirage
text: Got it. Plan: when a bid has a sharp book (Pinnacle, Circa, an exchange) whose price was read within about 90 s, its margin starts at your usual one and steps down as the game gets closer (so a bid that hasn't filled gets bolder), to a floor of 1.5% under that sharp book's own fair. Bids with no fresh sharp read keep today's margins. The bid still has to be +EV against every sharp book, and the stake stays as it is. It will be a switch in Settings (on by default), with tests and a log line. I'll tell you here when it ships.
